DJ Set

Day 2 | STEGI.RADIO Takeover 2026

Σάββατο 14 Φεβρουαρίου στις 20:00 | Onassis Stegi

The Onassis Stegi transforms for STEGI.RADIO's second day of takeover. The building's brutalist surfaces become canvas, its spaces become stations, and the line between institution and underground dissolves for the weekend. You're walking into a building that's temporarily forgotten it's supposed to be a cultural center.

Day 2 of the STEGI.RADIO Takeover continues what the first day established — Athens' community radio station expanding into physical space, bringing the DJs and selectors who populate the airwaves into direct contact with the listeners who dial in. The programming runs the spectrum of electronic music, each hour shifting as different hosts claim the decks.

The Stegi crowd on takeover weekends reads different than usual programming. The regulars who come for theater and exhibitions share space with the electronic music faithful who recognized the names on the schedule. You'll find people moving between floors, chasing different sounds, treating the building as a festival site with architecture. By afternoon the building has developed its own rhythm, different rooms offering different energies.

Onassis Stegi's architecture serves this kind of event perfectly. Multiple levels, diverse spaces, the kind of institutional resources that community radio could never afford independently. The collision of contexts creates something neither could achieve alone.

If you need a traditional club night with clear progression, the takeover format will disorient you. Programming runs long, shifts constantly, rewards exploration over commitment to a single floor. But if you've been waiting for the moment when Athens underground radio gets the venue it deserves, when the city's selectors gather under one institutional roof — day 2 continues what day 1 started.
